senses.gloss: to go in a straight line, to shoot forth.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12">Num. R. s. 12</cite> <he>יש מזיק … וקוֹשֵׁט כחץ</he> some demon flies like a bird and shoots through the air like an arrow; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 91">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCI</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 842">Yalk. ib. 842</cite> <he>וקוֹשֵׁת</he>; Tanḥ. Naso 23 <he>וקושש</he> (corr. acc.); ed. Bub. 28.—
Y. Meg. I, 72ᵇ מאיכן ק׳ הקוֹשֵׁט הזה וכ׳ whence did this archer shoot (whence did he derive the opinion) that &c. (cmp. יָרָה Hif.).

senses.gloss: to shoot, aim, direct. Tosef. Erub. IX (VI), 26 ביבין המְקַשְּׁטִין וכ׳ ed. Zuck. (Var. המשקטין, המְקַשְׁקְשִׁין, v. קִשְׁקֵשׁ II) gutters which gush under the houses (cmp. קָלַח).
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3">Lam. R. to III, 12</cite> <he>מקושטים בה</he> Ar. s. v. <cite ref="S00588"><he>קורה</he></cite>, read: <he>מְקַשְּׁטִים</he> (Ar. ed. Koh. <he>מְקוֹשְׁשִׁים</he>; ed. <cite ref="M00653"><he>מוֹרִים</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="H01487"><he>חֵץ</he></cite>.—Part. pass. <he>מְקוּשָּׁט</he>; f. <he>מְקוּשֶּׁטֶת</he>; pl. <he>מְקוּשָּׁטִים</he>, <he>מְקוּשָּׁטִין</he>; <he>מְקוּשָּׁטוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 40:1">Pesik. R. s. 40</cite> (play on <cite ref="M00643"><he>מוריה</he></cite>, with ref. to <he>ירה יירה</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 19:13">Ex. XIX, 13</cite>) <he>שהיתה מק׳ כנגד וכ׳</he> it (the holy land) was aimed towards (directly under) the heavenly altar (v. <cite ref="K00296"><he>כּוּן</he></cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 988:31">Yalk. Cant. 988</cite>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 988:31">Ib.</cite> <he>כשם שגודלת הזו … להיות מקושטים וכ׳</he> (not <he>מקושטת</he>) as the hair-dresser dressing the bride puts every ornament in its proper place, so must the words of the Law be aimed, every word in its due place.

senses.gloss: (cmp. תקן) to dress, adorn, prepare. Ib. שמְקַשֶּׁטֶת לכלה, v. supra.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8">Gen. R. s. 8</cite> <he>מְקַשֵּׁט כלות</he> he (the Lord) attires brides; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:2">Koh. R. to VII, 2</cite>.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:2">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 18:1">Gen. R. s. 18</cite> <he>משקִשְּׁטָהּ וכ׳</he> after having fitted her out with twenty-four kinds of ornaments; a. fr.—Part. pass. as ab.

Sabb. 25ᵇ מטה מוצעת ואשה מק׳ לתלמיד חכם the scholar’s happiness when the couch is spread and the wife dressed (for the Sabbath). Ib. 153ᵃ כשהן מק׳ in festive dress, opp. מלוכלכין; a. fr.—Trnsf. to set right, correct.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 18a:11">Snh. 18ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>התקוששו וקושו</he>, <cite ref="Zephaniah 2:1">Zeph. II, 1</cite>) <he>קַשֵּׁט … קשט אחרים</he> first correct thyself, then correct others; ib. 19ᵃ; <cite ref="Bava Batra 60b">B. Bath. 60ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 107b:15">B. Mets. 107ᵇ</cite> <he>קְשׁוֹט וכ׳</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 302:2">Yalk. Jer. 302</cite>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 53:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. LIII</cite> <he>אם תרצה לקַשֵּׁט אחרים וכ׳</he> if thou wishest to correct others, correct thyself first.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 28">Gen. R. s. 28</cite> <he>הקב״ה היפך … והִקְשִׁיטָן וכ׳</he> the Lord turned day into night and prepared them for visitations; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 920:3">Yalk. Job 920</cite> <he>והתקינן</he>).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2">Num. R. s. 2</cite> <he>אבן יקרה שמִתְקַשְּׁטוֹת וכ׳</he> a precious stone with which women adorn themselves; a. e.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 55:1">Gen. R. s. 55</cite> <he>בשביל שתִּתְקַשֵּׁט וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="S00662"><he>קוֹשֶׁט</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 95:7">Yalk. ib. 95</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 777:6">Yalk. Ps. 777</cite>.
